classification: Post-review descriptive sensitivity; not a modification of original confirmatory inference
replacement_rule: Replace only the 75 historical OrganSMNIST standard runs with their historical no-hflip counterparts; preserve other 150 runs exactly
limitations: Only 9 crossed dataset/backbone contexts and 5 paired seeds.
Chi-square Friedman p is asymptotic; block dependence remains in the requested reconstruction.
Exact paired seed tests have minimum two-sided p=0.0625 with 5 nonzero pairs.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted and fragile at these sample sizes.
Historical standard and no-hflip sources have separately recorded code hashes; neither is the stabilized revision engine.
Vertical flipping and rotation remain in historical no-hflip; no claim of anatomical safety.
No favorable rank pattern or superiority is assumed before calculation.
